The '''Nazzri system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nazzri]], which was inhabited by the [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]].

It was the site of a major [[Battle of the Nazzri system (Great Sith War)|battle]] in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], and [[Battle of the Nazzri system (Mandalorian Wars)|another]] in the [[Mandalorian Wars]]

==Appearances==
*''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'' {{1st}} {{C|Appears on screen only}}
